notes: Body dereferences the context table at base+0xf10, accumulates several 16-bit entries at offsets 0xa6, 0xb8, 0x148, and 0x1d8 based on supplied indices, and returns their sum with a lookup result. Multiple callers use it as a numeric modifier in attribute calculations.

Body independently processes three record pointers at base offsets 0x10, 0x120, and 0x230, compares fetched values, checks a byte flag at record+0xa2, and conditionally writes the chosen value and record pointer through output arguments. Caller is in attribute-processing flow.

Body initializes state and sample bookkeeping, validates indices/counts, dispatches state-specific work, appends a computed sample, and integrates fallback state when append fails. Both direct callers are named pitch-flight routines and tail-call this helper.

Validates two indices, checks enable/support conditions, then increments byte counters at offsets 1, 0, and 2 conditionally and offset 3 on the accepted path. Callers pass flags and context indices from attribute processing.

Scans up to 0xd07 entries from a global table, trying four lookup/match stages per entry; on a complete match it invokes a registration helper, then performs cleanup after the scan. Caller follows frontend player-stat initialization and gates this routine on its success. Batch has no blank rows to sample.
